summary: iter19 — bulk-upload (parent_password + .school TLD + credentials list), edit/delete student RBAC (teacher own-class), credential-slip PDF, send-credentials (telegram/whatsapp/sms + reset_first), bulk-export parent creds, TeachersPage user CRUD, StudentUpdate gender/dob. BACKEND: 25/25 pytest cases PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_iter19_bulk_creds.py (8.71s). Verified: (1) /uploads/template/students has 11 headers with parent_password last; (2) /uploads/students applies explicit parent_password>=6 (login works with that exact pwd), falls back to Parent@123 when blank or <6 chars, uses synthetic *.school TLD (login works), returns credentials[] with parent_was_created and parent_password=null for reused parent_email; (3) /uploads/parent-credentials xlsx has 9 expected headers + 5+ active Grade-5-A rows; teacher 403; (4) PATCH /students/{id} as teacher in own (Grade 5 A) succeeds; in Grade 6 B → 403; cross-class move to Grade 6 B → 403 with 'classes you teach' detail; DELETE soft-sets status=inactive (teacher own ok, other 403); gender/dob persists; blank '' coerced to None; (5) credential-slip returns application/pdf, attachment disposition, starts with %PDF, ~2.3KB; teacher own ok / other 403 / accounts 403; (6) send-credentials validates channel, reset_first=true → parent login with Parent@123 works after; delivery_status='queued' (Telegram unset, expected); teacher other-class 403, accounts 403, anon 401; (7) POST /students still returns parent_login; (8) POST/PATCH/DELETE /users CRUD by school_admin works; teacher cannot PATCH users (403). FRONTEND (live verified): /school/teachers has 9 edit-user-btn-*/9 toggle-user-btn-*/9 delete-user-btn-* and edit-user-modal opens with edit-user-active toggle + 5 edit-user-subject-* chips. /school/students has 64 edit-student-btn-*/64 slip-btn-*/64 send-creds-btn-*/61 deactivate-student-btn-* (61 active subset) plus bulk-export-creds-btn (correctly disabled until class filter chosen). send-creds-modal mounts with send-creds-channel-telegram/whatsapp/sms chips + send-creds-reset-first toggle. ONE MINOR FRONTEND FINDING: edit-student-modal did not appear after clicking edit-student-btn-* in the harness (modal element not in DOM after the click). Possible state/portal mounting timing issue or modal closes immediately if no row data — flagged for main agent verification.

critical_code_review_comments: uploads.py:102 synthetic email uses school_id[:6]+'.school' deterministically; .school is a valid IANA TLD so EmailStr accepts it. parent_password handling at lines 104-114 correctly: (a) keeps explicit pwd>=6, (b) falls back to Parent@123 if blank/short, (c) re-hashes pwd if reused parent rows supply a stronger pwd (line 110-114).

uploads.py:161-168 credentials[] response correctly emits parent_password ONLY when parent_was_created=true. Reused parent → parent_password=null. parent_was_created flag set deterministically before insert.

students.py:271-277 + 364-370 RBAC for /credential-slip and /send-credentials reuses _teacher_class_filter intersection (class_teacher_map ∪ timetable) — same pattern as PATCH/DELETE; consistent and correct.
students.py:382-385 reset_first writes hash_password('Parent@123') + password_reset_to_default_at audit field. ✓ verified by post-reset login.

students.py:391-409 queue_notification('parent_credentials' template) — phone defaults to parent_whatsapp when channel=whatsapp, else parent_phone; telegram_chat_id passed only when channel=telegram. Clean dispatch logic.

students.py:502-506 teacher move validation — uses union of update.class_id/section with current values so partial updates (only section or only class_id) still validate against the target combo. Correct.
uploads.py:260-264 /uploads/parent-credentials is school_admin only — teacher correctly 403. Reasonable given bulk export of all parents in a class is an admin-scoped action.
core/models.py StudentUpdate now accepts gender + dob (with _blank_to_none) — verified via PATCH with both populated and blank values; persists / coerces correctly.
